bullets_zh: 发布开源BCI基准平台MOABB的v1.7.2版本。
修复TRCA和TRCSP与pyRiemann均值API的兼容性，包括gmean支持。
增加对TRCSP指标和TRCA协方差处理的回归测试覆盖。
bullets_en: Releases MOABB version 1.7.2 for the open-source BCI benchmarking platform.
Fixes TRCA and TRCSP compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs, including gmean support.
Adds regression coverage for TRCSP metrics and TRCA covariance handling.
items.brief_en: MOABB benchmark library update fixing pyRiemann compatibility.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs. - Use `gmean` in TRCA and TRCSP, supporting pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions. - Pass the TRCSP metric by keyword to fix fitting with pyRiemann 0.12. - Add regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance means. bullets_zh: MOABB将数据集气泡图中的全局NumPy随机状态替换为显式random_state参数。
固定默认值使重复调用生成相同图形，提升基准可视化的可复现性。
bullets_en: MOABB replaces the global NumPy random state in dataset bubble plots with an explicit random_state parameter.
A fixed default makes repeated calls produce identical figures, improving reproducibility of benchmark visualizations.
items.brief: MOABB更新使数据集气泡图可复现，提升基准可视化可靠性。

bullets_zh: MOABB在预取NEMAR前优先使用缓存数据，避免不必要的远程下载。
该更新在移除缓存后仍保留原有NEMAR优先行为，减少网络负载并加速访问。
bullets_en: MOABB uses cached data before prefetching NEMAR, avoiding unnecessary remote fetches.
It preserves the original NEMAR-first behavior after cache removal, reducing network load and speeding access.
